name: harvestgo
description: HarvestGo: farm operations monitoring and compliance documentation system for Kabutihan Farm

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @harvestgo/api" "npm run dev -w @harvestgo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @harvestgo/api && npm run build -w @harvestgo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @harvestgo/api && npm run typecheck -w @harvestgo/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @harvestgo/api
